mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have partly cloudy skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 75 degrees and an air quality index of 53. The moon is in a waning crescent phase. We expect an overnight low of 66 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is offering free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail for those looking to enjoy the outdoors. Additionally, the city is reminding residents that they can apply for a rain barrel rebate to help manage stormwater run-off on their private property.
There is plenty to do, with Live Music at Bailey's Run and a Girls Try Hockey event both happening today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can catch a yoga class at Insight Wellness.

To keep you informed, the Verona Police Department noted that on July 28th, an officer found a vehicle occupied after hours in Fireman's Park, which resulted in a man being taken into custody on an active arrest warrant.
Today's delicious flavor is Snickers Swirl, and the store is open until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to satisfy your craving.
